import Mathlib

theorem p02 (n : ℕ) : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) := by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exact ⟨k * (n + 1), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exact ⟨n * (k + 1), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
